levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

notes: «وهو ابن محمد» is an editor gloss and is left out
«أخبره عن أبيه» names the father only by relation, so he is a relation link
Abu Bakr is the subject of the story («قام أبو بكر الصديق») and the words quoted after it; whether he is the last link (rule 6) is not settled by the text, so he is not written and a ruling is needed
